testTitle: HSSC CET Mains Practice Set - Mock Test 1 (Extracted Batch 1)
description:
Mock Test-1 (Questions 1-10)

This batch is extracted from the HSSC CET Mains practice booklet. The answers have been matched with the answer key shown on the last page of the file.

questions.q_en: Currently, the Grand Trunk Road in India runs from where to where?
questions.q_hi: वर्तमान में, ग्रैंड ट्रंक रोड भारत में कहाँ से कहाँ तक जाती है?
questions.explanation: Answer key marks option 2. The Grand Trunk Road in India is commonly identified from Amritsar to Kolkata.

questions.q_en: According to the 2011 Census, what is the male literacy rate in India?
questions.q_hi: 2011 की जनगणना के अनुसार, भारत में पुरुष साक्षरता दर कितनी है?
questions.explanation: Answer key marks option 3, which is 82.14%.

questions.q_en: In 1979, who shared the Nobel Prize with George Wittig for the development of boron- and phosphorus-based reagents in organic synthesis?
questions.q_hi: 1979 में, जॉर्ज विटिग के साथ उनके कार्बनिक संश्लेषण में महत्वपूर्ण अभिकर्मकों में क्रमशः बोरॉन- और फास्फोरस युक्त यौगिकों के उपयोग के विकास के लिए नोबेल पुरस्कार किसने साझा किया था?
questions.explanation: Answer key marks option 4. The correct name is Herbert C. Brown.

questions.q_en: Which activity is not included in marketing research?
questions.q_hi: विपणन शोध के क्षेत्र में कौन-सी क्रिया शामिल नहीं है?
questions.explanation: Answer key marks option 1. Advertising is not a marketing research activity.

questions.q_en: What is the focal point of marketing?
questions.explanation: Answer key marks option 3. In marketing, the customer is the focal point.
Answer key marks option 4. Marketing is considered complete when customers are satisfied.

questions.q_en: The term 'marketing mix' was first used by:
questions.q_hi: विपणन मिश्रण शब्द का सबसे पहले प्रयोग किया था :
questions.explanation: Answer key marks option 3. Neil H. Borden is associated with the term 'marketing mix'.

questions.q_en: Which factor does not affect the marketing mix?
questions.q_hi: कौन सा तत्व विपणन मिश्रण को प्रभावित नहीं करता ?
questions.explanation: Answer key marks option 3. Production quantity is not treated as a direct marketing-mix factor here.

questions.q_en: Bimbavati Devi is the exponent of which Indian dance style?
questions.q_hi: बिबावती देवी किस भारतीय नृत्य शैली की प्रतिपादक हैं?
questions.explanation: Answer key marks option 4. Bimbavati Devi is associated with Manipuri dance.

questions.q_en: What has the Mughal Garden been renamed as?
questions.q_hi: मुगल गार्डन का नाम बदलकर क्या कर दिया है?
questions.explanation: Answer key marks option 2. The new name is Amrit Udyan.
